name: Chonk Hawk
hook: Waddle down the coop buffet before gravity reclaims your raptor wings
tagline: An outrageously plump hawk attempts to lift off from an all-you-can-eat chicken ranch as the multiplier climbs. Cashing out triggers a clumsy glide into a fluffy hay cart with a drumstick intact. Crashing sends the heavyweight bird thudding into the mud with an exhausted burp and flying feathers.
